description: Tecnologías de Telecomunicaciones de CLM is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. The Telecommunications Information Centre is a collaborative tool between the different actors involved in regional telecommunications. Disseminating, informing and collaborating around telecommunications are its main objectives. The information contained is available by electronic means for free and can be accessed using the map. The attached pdf specifies instructions for downloading in reusable format. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. The portal shows the English title as "CLM Telecommunications Technologies" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. Its keywords include EDUCACIÓN Y CIENCIA, Innovación tecnológica, Telecomunicaciones. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF, HTML. The listing shows 2023-06-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/es/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
